title: Aruba Eagle Beach Ultimate Tour and How to Get There the Easy Way - Closest Beach to Cruise Port
description:
Aruba's Eagle Beach is one of the top beaches rated in the World and #1 in the Caribbean.  I want to give you the ultimate tour of Eagle Beach  and the best way to get there if coming in on a cruise ship. And it is cheap to take the bus too. Also do not miss the sunset this is the best beach in Aruba to see the sun go down. If you get there early enough they have some grass covered umbrella that are free to use during your day stay.
